flagged.evidence: The proof says “the Poincare polynomials agree: P_{M',F}(t)=P_{M,F}(t) ... by [F3].” [F3] gives the definitions of the Morse and Poincare polynomials, not invariance of singular homology under the diffeomorphism supplied by [F1]. The conclusion follows from homotopy invariance, but that result is not among this item's cited facts or dependencies.

The proof uses “H_j(W_{k-1}) → H_j(W_k) → H_j(W_k,W_{k-1})=0” to conclude the first map is an isomorphism for j>k. This fragment gives surjectivity; injectivity also uses the preceding term H_{j+1}(W_k,W_{k-1}), which vanishes by Proof 2.1 when j>k. Adding that term closes this small gap.
